headline: A law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Guntersville, Alabama, after Colonel Ola Lee Mize.
what_it_does: This act officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Guntersville, Alabama, the Colonel Ola Lee Mize Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic. It changes the clinic's official name only. It does not change the services the clinic offers or how veterans use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
